mutants.label: [control] reorder independent keyword arguments
mutants.why: The keyword arguments are bound by name, and both values are already computed local values or a side-effect-free bool conversion. Swapping their source order leaves the call and chronicle output identical for every test path; this argument holds for this call site only.
